en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large early‑20th‑century institutional building, likely a school or municipal facility, with steep hipped roofs and dormer windows. The structure is three to four stories tall with a symmetrical façade, arched entrances, and a low stone base. It is flanked by smaller auxiliary buildings of similar style. In the foreground are fenced fields, trees, and a rural landscape; in the background are rows of multi‑story residential houses and a gently rolling hillside. The overall composition looks like the edge of a European town transitioning into the countryside. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
